usedFor: TimeRex books meetings and Brevo runs the mailing lists, so “New Event” can feed “Add Contacts To List”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Event” in TimeRex, then “Add Contacts To List” in Brevo
bestTemplate.why: Someone who books a meeting joins the list you choose.

watchOut: “Add Contacts To List” takes existing contacts, so the booker must exist in Brevo first.
